archetypes.name: dyn-review-topology
archetypes.rationale: Changed dispatch topology and model-role routing can regress round gating or fallback behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed review dispatch paths in python/plan_review_panel.py, python/review_pipeline.py, and python/agent_waterfall.py. Verify the generic Codex rows appear only in rounds 1 and 2, remain unconditional when Codex is unavailable, and pass model_role=default while specialist rows inherit review. Check that dynamic and specialist Codex rows remain otherwise unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-static-coverage
archetypes.rationale: Static reviewer threshold fallback now recognizes a new generic Codex basename.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the static coverage and reviewer failure-threshold changes in python/review_pipeline.py. Pay special attention to stale collector data, dropped-slot mapping, status precedence, and whether codex-generalist-output.txt can be silently skipped. Confirm the new tests exercise both success and failure paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
